hints.title: Definition of Echo Substring
hints.text: An echo substring has even length 2 * L and consists of two identical concatenated halves of length L.

hints.title: Iterate Possible Half Lengths
hints.text: For each possible half length L from 1 to len(text) // 2, compare text[i : i + L] with text[i + L : i + 2 * L].

hints.title: Collect Unique Substrings
hints.text: Add every matching echo substring to a set of distinct strings. The size of the set is the answer.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Arbitrary substring extraction and string hashing can be slow without structured length grouping.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Iterating length L and using string slicing or rolling hashes finds all unique echoes in quadratic time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate explores fixed-length halves or rolling hash comparison to identify duplicates.
complexity.notes: Rolling hash can optimize comparisons to O(1) per window.
